voiceover: You built the app. But how do you make people care?
title: You built the app.

voiceover: Meet Angle. A creative research partner for app builders who would rather build than spend hours studying the feed.
title: Find your next creative direction.

voiceover: Start with your app and the promise you want to show. Angle searches with Oriane, through what videos show, say, and write on screen.
title: Search inside the video.

voiceover: It looks beyond direct competitors, to nearby problems and useful demonstrations. Then it filters the noise and brings back references with real interaction signals.
title: Useful patterns. Real references.

voiceover: Open a direction and see the evidence. The hook. The product moment. The exact frame. Every interpretation stays connected to its source.
title: See why it fits.

voiceover: For Sokka, show a simple story: too many saved videos, one real plan. Angle turns that direction into a storyboard you can shoot.
title: An idea you can actually shoot.

voiceover: Change the promise, and the research changes. Finding a missing address leads to clues, visual search, and a reveal. Different value. Different creative direction.
title: Different promise. Different angle.

voiceover: From video evidence to your next idea. Angle. Find your angle. Then make it yours.
title: Find your angle.
